questions.question: Which Session of Congress and Muslim League reached an understanding of creating a joint front against the British regime?
questions.solution:
• Pact: Lucknow
  • Unity: The Lucknow Pact (1916) brought the Moderates, Extremists, and Muslim League onto one platform.

questions.question: The Ryotwari Settlement, in which cultivators had to pay annual taxes directly to the government, was primarily introduced in which of the following provinces?
questions.solution:
• Provinces: Madras and Bombay
  • Revenue: It was introduced in Madras by Alexander Read and Thomas Munro.

questions.question: Who introduced the Zamindari Settlement as a measure of land revenue administration?
questions.solution:
• Settlement: Lord Cornwallis
  • 1793: The Permanent Settlement created a new class of landlords (Zamindars) in Bengal and Bihar.

questions.question: In ________, Lord Curzon, the Viceroy of India, announced the partition of Bengal.
questions.solution:
• Partition: 1905
  • Viceroy: Lord Curzon’s partition of Bengal led to the Swadeshi Movement and the boycott of British goods.

questions.question: When and at which place did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre take place?
questions.solution:
• Massacre: 13 April 1919, at Amritsar
  • Event: General Dyer ordered troops to fire on a peaceful crowd celebrating Baisakhi.

questions.question: Who among the following Sultans of Delhi started the system of Sijda and Paibos?
questions.solution:
• Sultan: Ghiyas ud din Balban
  • Customs: He introduced Persian etiquette to show the Sultan was the 'Shadow of God' (Zil-i-Ilahi).

questions.question: Who among the following Mauryan rulers conquered Kalinga?
questions.solution:
• Conqueror: Ashoka
  • Kalinga: This was the only major war Ashoka fought after becoming emperor.

questions.question: Primarily under whose persuasion did Mahatma Gandhi visit Champaran to understand the problems of peasants?
questions.solution:
• Invite: Rajkumar Shukla
  • Champaran: He persisted for months to get Gandhi to investigate the Tinkathia system of indigo farming.

questions.question: In which of the following cities is the Quwwat al-Islam mosque situated?
questions.solution:
• Mosque: Delhi
  • Sultanate: The Quwwat al-Islam was the first mosque built in Delhi, using parts of 27 Hindu and Jain temples.

questions.question: Khan Bahadur led the revolt of 1857 from:
questions.solution:
• Rebel: Bareilly
  • 1857: Khan Bahadur Khan established a formal government in Rohilkhand during the uprising.

questions.question: Which of the following cities was sacked by victorious armies after the battle of Talikota?
questions.solution:
• Sacking: Vijayanagar
  • Battle: Following the Battle of Talikota, the Deccan Sultanates destroyed the city of Hampi over five months.

questions.question: The ‘Pattanulkars’ migrated from the Gujarat region to the Vijayanagar state. They were _________.
questions.solution:
• Weavers: silk weavers
  • Migration: These Saurashtrian weavers provided the royal family with high-end luxury fabrics.

questions.question: How many classes of Indian society are mentioned in Megasthene's book Indica?
questions.solution:
• Classes: 7
  • Megasthenes: He failed to understand the four-fold Varna system and classified Indians by their profession instead.
